DND5E_SUPPLIER.Title: Supplier (D&D 5e)
DND5E_SUPPLIER.EmptyHint: Choose a profile, set party level and size, then generate stock.

Confirm.Title: Confirm Supplier Stock
Confirm.Question: Create a named Folder in the World Items Directory and place every generated Item inside it?

Settings.MenuHint: Configure compendium sources, party progression, prices, output, and Supplier profiles.

Config.Title: Supplier Configuration
Config.SourcesHint: Enable Item packs and order their priority. Disabled packs are not indexed. Higher sources win when duplicate items are found.
Config.ProfileHint: Build each Supplier from globally enabled packs, profile-specific sources, stock targets, guaranteed coverage, and random pools.
Config.ProgressionHint: Configure party-level rarity access, spell-circle access, enhancement probabilities, and positive fallback prices.
Config.OutputHint: Configure the World Items Folder created when the generated stock is confirmed.
Config.ProfileSourcesHint: This profile can use only these globally enabled packs.
Config.StockTargetHint: Guaranteed units consume this target. When enabled, random rules fill only the remaining units.
Config.GuaranteedHint: Guaranteed rules reserve units inside the target. They can select exact Items, lists, canonical families, structured categories, or generated Spell Scrolls.
Config.RandomHint: Random rules fill the remaining target or add their own configured quantities.
Config.OnePerSelectedGroup: One result for each selected subgroup.
Config.Exclusions: Excluded identifiers or names, comma separated
Config.LevelBandsHint: Each level range defines accessible rarities and the maximum spell level for Spell Scroll generation.
Config.EnchantmentBandsHint: Weights decide whether eligible base weapons and armor remain mundane or become +1, +2, or +3. A rule's minimum enchanted floor is applied after these rolls.
Config.PriceFallbacksHint: Used only when the chosen Item and its duplicate sources have no positive price.
Config.QualityPriceAdditionsHint: Added to the base price when Supplier generates a synthetic +1, +2, or +3 weapon or armor.
Config.SaveHint: Changes affect the next stock generation.
Config.MustKeepProfile: At least one Supplier profile must remain.
Config.ProfileHumanHint: Choose sources, then build the vendor in three clear layers: mundane catalog, guaranteed items, and random items.
Config.ThemeHint: Choose a visual theme. Technical icon classes are only shown for the Custom theme.
Config.VariableStockTargetHint: This target applies only to random Items. Mundane and guaranteed Items are additional.
Config.PoolValidationHint: Every rule shows how many eligible Items it can currently find.
Config.MundaneCatalogHint: Includes every eligible mundane Item in the category. Quantity is applied to each distinct Item and does not consume random slots.
Config.GuaranteedHumanHint: Guaranteed Items are additional to the random total. Quantity N creates N independent Item and quality rolls.
Config.RandomHumanHint: Every enabled pool competes for the configured random slots. Weight controls how often each pool wins a slot.
Config.NoRulesYet: No rules in this section yet.
Config.SubtypeOrHint: Selecting more than one subtype uses OR: an Item may match any selected subtype.
Config.HealingFamilyHint: Each slot independently rolls among Potion of Healing, Greater, Superior, and Supreme versions currently allowed by party rarity.
Config.RandomStockSizeHint: Random stock is calculated separately from guaranteed categories. Party-scaled modes use the configured base party size, and level-band modes also use party level.
Config.RandomQuantityMode: How is the random total calculated?
Config.RandomTargetAdditional: Mundane and guaranteed Items do not consume these slots.
Config.RandomPoolWeightHint: Higher weights win more of the random slots.
Config.BannedItemsHint: Manage exclusions separately for each Supplier profile.
Config.GlobalBanListHint: Items added here are excluded from Mundane Catalogs, Guaranteed categories, Random pools, and exact-item browsing. Duplicate versions in other enabled sources are blocked together.
Config.ClickToUnban: Click to remove this Item from the ban list
Config.NativeSubtypesHint: These options come from the Items themselves. Select one or more subtypes; selected subtypes use OR.
Config.TwoStageRollHint: Two-stage roll: first choose one selected subtype, then choose one eligible Item inside it.
Config.SourceQualityWarning: This mode selects ready-made source Items. Named magic Items such as Adamantine Armor may appear when their rarity and enhancement are allowed for the party level.
Config.PartyQualityExplanation: This mode selects mundane base Items first, then rolls +0, +1, +2, or +3 separately for each slot using the party progression table.
Config.ProfileBannedItemsHint: These documents are excluded only from the selected Supplier profile. Use the browser to ban exact source versions or every equivalent version.
Config.NoProfileBannedItems: This profile has no banned Items.
Config.ProgressionProfilesHint: Create, duplicate, and activate progression profiles. Supplier profiles define what may be sold and may use the World Default or select one of these profiles explicitly.
Config.RecommendedNotOfficial: Uses the official D&D 2024 rarity and price structures. Vendor-stock quantities and availability remain Supplier defaults because D&D does not define one universal merchant-stock progression.
Config.PoolBadgeHint: Configurable Items in this pool. Party-level availability is applied only when stock is generated.
Config.PoolConfigurationHint: The configuration list shows every Item allowed by sources, type, subtype, bans, and local curation. Level and rarity availability are applied only during generation.
Config.MechanicalItemsGlobalHint: Documents used by D&D5e for rules automation are not normal merchandise. The recommended policy excludes detected mechanical Items before Supplier pools are built.
Config.ExcludeMechanicalAutomatically: Exclude detected mechanical Items automatically — recommended
Config.ExcludeMechanicalAutomaticallyHint: Turn this off to include every detected mechanical document by default. Each Supplier profile can still override individual source versions.
Config.MechanicalItemsProfileHint: Review every detected rules-only document from this profile’s sources. The checkbox controls whether that exact source version is excluded; clicking the Item opens its original compendium sheet.
Config.GlobalMechanicalExclusionOn: Global policy: detected mechanical Items are excluded by default. Changes below are source-specific overrides for this Supplier profile.
Config.GlobalMechanicalExclusionOff: Global policy: detected mechanical Items are allowed by default. Changes below are source-specific overrides for this Supplier profile.
Config.ToggleMechanicalExclusion: Check to exclude this exact source document from this Supplier profile.
Config.NoMechanicalItemsDetected: No recognized system-mechanical Items were found in this profile’s enabled sources.
Config.ProfileProgressionHint: Choose the progression profile used by this Supplier. World Default follows the globally active profile.
Config.HomebrewNotOfficial: HAMMER Homebrew Level, Quality & Price progression adapted from the vendor-roll compendium into direct percentages and weighted pools.
Config.CustomProgressionNote: This is a custom progression profile. Supplier profiles choose what may be sold; this profile controls what can be generated for the entered party level.
Config.UseCorePricingHint: Use the shared Item Creator rarity-price profile for this Level, Quality & Price preset. Disable it to use the values stored in this preset.
Config.CorePricingActive: This Level, Quality & Price profile currently uses the shared Materialization Core rarity prices.
Config.LevelPartyScaledRandomTotal: Level bands scaled by party size
Config.StockLevelBandsHint: Total stock and Scroll stock are baseline values for the base party size. Supplier scales them to the current number of party members.
Config.PartyScaledQuantity: Baseline slots scaled by party size
Config.LevelPartyScaledScrolls: Scroll slots from the active level band
Config.AvailabilityControlsHint: Use 0 for no access limit or no family cap. Access is separate from rarity and party-level progression.

Errors.NoCatalog: No enabled Item compendium produced a usable catalog. Configure Supplier sources first.
Errors.NoProfileCatalog: The selected profile has no usable Items in its enabled sources and Item types.
Errors.NotEnoughUnique: Rule “{rule}” requested {requested} unique Items, but only {available} were available.
Errors.NoUnlockedEnchantment: The enchanted minimum could not be met because no positive enhancement is unlocked for this party level.
Errors.GuaranteedExceedsTarget: Guaranteed stock generated {guaranteed} units, exceeding the target of {target}.
Errors.TargetNotFilled: The stock target was not completely filled. Generated {generated} of {target} units.
Errors.NothingGenerated: No Items were generated. Review warnings and profile filters.
Errors.ScrollApiUnavailable: The installed D&D5e system does not expose the native Spell Scroll creation routine.
Errors.ScrollCreationFailed: Could not create a Spell Scroll from {spell}.
Errors.RandomTargetNotFilled: The random stock target was not completely filled. Generated {generated} of {target} random Items.
Errors.GeneratorNoEligibleResult: The generator model “{item}” has no eligible concrete result in this Supplier profile.
Errors.GeneratorQualityUnavailable: The generator model “{item}” cannot produce an unlocked enhancement for party level {level}.
Errors.MaterializationFailed: The model “{item}” could not be materialized safely.
Errors.BlueprintNoEligibleResult: The blueprint “{item}” has no compatible concrete base Item in this Supplier profile.
Errors.MechanicalDocumentSelected: The mechanical document “{item}” cannot be placed directly in merchant stock.
Errors.MaterializerRerolled: The materializer “{item}” could not produce a safe result and the slot was rerolled as “{replacement}”.

Picker.Title: Select Supplier Item
Picker.Hint: Results are limited to the packs and Item types enabled for this Supplier profile.
Picker.BanScope: How should the selected Items be banned?
Picker.BanThisSourceHint: Recommended. Other versions from SRD, PHB, DMG, or modules remain eligible.
Picker.BanAllSourcesHint: Blocks Items with the same normalized name and document type in every source enabled for this profile.

PoolReason.category: choose a category or enable a matching source pack
PoolReason.exact: the selected Item is not available in this profile sources
PoolReason.subtype: the subtype filters removed all Items
PoolReason.magic: the mundane/magical filter removed all Items
PoolReason.rarity: the rarity rules removed all Items
PoolReason.spellLevel: the spell-level rule removed all Spells
PoolReason.exclusion: the exclusion rules removed all Items
PoolReason.curation: the Homebrew profile curation removed all Items
PoolReason.access: the vendor Access Level removed all commercially restricted Items

PoolInspector.Title: Pool contents
PoolInspector.Hint: The checkbox controls whether an Item may be rolled by this rule. This is local curation; it does not ban the Item from the Supplier profile.
PoolInspector.ToggleHint: Include or remove this Item from this pool
PoolInspector.FooterHint: Saving changes only this rule. Use Banned Items to exclude a document from the entire Supplier profile.
PoolInspector.ToggleSubtype: Include or remove this subtype from the rule
PoolInspector.InspectSubtype: Inspect and curate the Items inside this subtype

Homebrew.CreateSupplierHint: Name the Supplier, then start blank or load a HAMMER Homebrew configuration.
Homebrew.CreateBlankHint: Start with no stock rules and build everything manually.
Homebrew.LoadHomebrewHint: Create an editable profile from a HAMMER Homebrew model.
Homebrew.LibraryHint: These models translate the logic of the Humeth vendor-roll compendium into the Supplier filters. They are Homebrew, not official merchant-stock rules.
Homebrew.AccessLevelHint: Access controls commercial reach, restricted families, and relic availability. Party level controls power and quality; party size controls quantity.
Homebrew.Access1Hint: Small or modest establishment with focused stock.
Homebrew.Access3Hint: Large or specialized supplier with broad stock and access to ordinary legendary merchandise.
Homebrew.EditAfterCreate: The created profile is a normal editable Supplier. Loading a Homebrew model never locks its rules.
Homebrew.BlacksmithHint: Weapons, armor, shields, ammunition, and level-based enhancements.
Homebrew.BlacksmithDescription: HAMMER Homebrew blacksmith with mundane combat equipment, guaranteed coverage, and level-based enhancement rolls.
Homebrew.AlchemistHint: Healing potions, potions, poisons, oils, powders, and alchemical consumables.
Homebrew.AlchemistDescription: HAMMER Homebrew alchemist and herbalist with one healing-potion slot per player plus varied consumables.
Homebrew.MagicAssortmentHint: Spell Scrolls, rings, trinkets, clothing, wands, rods, and wondrous items.
Homebrew.MagicAssortmentDescription: HAMMER Homebrew arcane supplier focused on Spell Scrolls and magical equipment subtypes.
Homebrew.GeneralTradeHint: Complete mundane adventuring, camping, tool, kit, food, water, and container stock.
Homebrew.GeneralTradeDescription: HAMMER Homebrew trading post with broad mundane supplies and no magical stock.
Homebrew.StableLivestockHint: Animals, mounts, tack, feed, carts, and stable supplies.
Homebrew.StableLivestockDescription: HAMMER Homebrew stable and livestock supplier with selected animals, mounts, and related mundane equipment.
Homebrew.GunsmithHint: Firearms, firearm ammunition, powder, and gunsmith supplies.
Homebrew.GunsmithDescription: HAMMER Homebrew gunsmith focused on firearms, firearm ammunition, powder, and level-based enhancements.
Homebrew.AccessCustomHint: Custom Supplier profile. Its rules may no longer match a HAMMER Homebrew access preset.
Homebrew.Access4Hint: Exceptional supplier with the broadest commercial reach, including major relics and tightly restricted merchandise when party level permits it.
